en: \bByron: Gwahahaha! That's disappointing.
\rCandice: Ready to push beyond your limits with me, \PN? Let's focus, shall we?
\rCandice: Your focus melted the ice!
\rCandice: I'll focus even harder next time!
\bVolkner: Good to see you again, \PN. I know I can expect an exciting battle from you.
\bVolkner: That was electrifying!
\bVolkner: That was a thrilling battle!
\bAaron: Bug Pokémon are nasty-mean, and yet they're beautiful, too.
\bAaron: We were likes moths to a flame against you!
\bAaron: Don't underestimate Bug Pokémon!
\rBertha: Well \PN, would you show this old lady how much you've learned about observation?
\rBertha: Looks like someone's learned a lot about observation!
\rBertha: Looks like someone's still got a lot of learning to do.
\bFlint: I can feel your determination, \PN. Your will is truly on fire!
\bFlint: We were burned to ashes!
\bFlint: We burned you to ashes!
\bLucian: Ah, hello \PN. Shall we get started?
\bLucian: This'll make for a good book.
\bBarry: \PN! I'm fining you a million dollars if you try and run away from this battle!
\bBarry: I don't get it... Well, I'm fining you a million dollars anyway!
\bBarry: Hehe, I'm so happy! I can't even keep a straight face right now!
\rDawn: Hi \PN! Let me show you what I've learnt from contests since we last saw each other!
\rDawn: I guess you'll always be getting stronger. I'm going to get even better too!
\rDawn: How's that? Reckon I could take on the Sinnoh Grand Festival again now?
\bRowan: Hi \PN. It's been a long while since I battled, but I'll put up as much of a fight as I can.
\bRowan: Haha, as expected.
\bRowan: You definitely underestimated me too much!
\bCilan: \PN, fancy seeing you here! It's time for the battle to be served.
\bCilan: You served us a great battle!
\bCilan: Did we serve you a great battle?
\bChili: Let's get this heated up, \PN!
\bChili: Yeeeeooow! We got burned up!
\bChili: Awwww yeah! That was a fiery battle!
\bCress: Jumping into the deep end, \PN? How brave of you. Let's see how long that lasts!
\bCress: I see... Looks like we should've prepared for that.
\bCress: What incredible luck for us!
\rLenora: I'm going to read your moves and shut down your strategy, no matter what it may be.
\rLenora: I was completely outread!
\rLenora: Just as I said before.
\bBurgh: Are you able to give me an elegant battle that'll inspire me, \PN? Let's find out.
\bBurgh: Even though I lost, that was a truly inspiring battle!
\bBurgh: My Pokémon are still buzzing from that battle!
\rElesa: So this is the Pokémon World Championships? There's no better stage than for me and my Pokémon to shine. Think you can keep up with us, sweetie?
\rElesa: Your Pokémon were so dazzling! Keep shining, ok?
\rElesa: My Pokémon really dazzled on this stage!
\bClay: Ya ain't beating me again, \PN. I'll be making damn sure of that this time!
\bClay: Hmph, another fluke?
\bClay: Ya gotta be more headstrong than that to beat me!
\rSkyla: I know how this battle's gonna end already thanks to my Air Battle. Let's see if it holds.
\rSkyla: Haha, looks like traditional battles are truly the only way to find out the real outcome of a battle.
\rSkyla: See, what did I say? If you really wanna prove my Air Battle wrong, you've gotta do better than that!
\bBrycen: The stage is set, the actors are here, and the time is upon us. Let's begin.
\bBrycen: Of course, that was a real battle, not just a film with actors. You did well.
\bBrycen: And the hero is triumphant!
\rRoxie: Whatdya say, \PN? Let's turn it up to eleven and wow the crowd together with this battle!
\rRoxie: That spoke to my soul. You rock!
\rRoxie: That shook me to the core! Let's do this again sometime!
\bCheren: Ready to learn something from this battle, \PN? Every battle is a learning opportunity, after all.
\bCheren: I suppose I couldn't teach you much with this battle. I suppose if you were in my class, this would let you graduate!
\bCheren: Pay more attention to your opponent next time.
\bDrayden: \PN, thank you for helping Iris in her journey. Now, will you continue to grow, or will you stagnate here and fall to me?.
\bDrayden: Looks like you'll continue to grow stronger and stronger!
\bDrayden: Don't stagnate, otherwise things like this will happen.
\bMarlon: We should totally ride some waves together, dude!
\bMarlon: Yo, you really made a splash out there, dude!
\bMarlon: That was a sick battle, dude! Let's go for a swim together soon.
\rCaitlin: Who is so uncouth as to disturb my sleep? Hmm, \PN. Please, try not to bore me.
\rCaitlin: That was difficult to be bored by. Not bad.
\rCaitlin: That was a bore. I suppose I'll be taking my leave and going back to sleep now.
\rBianca: Oops, let me find my Poké Balls... There they are. Let's battle, \PN!
\rBianca: Me? Oh! I'd love to join you!
\rBianca: Bye-bye!!
\rJuniper: In this battle, show me what you've learned from your adventures in Unova and beyond, \PN!
\rJuniper: You sure showed me a lot! Keep exploring the world, \PN!
\rJuniper: Looks like you didn't get to show me everything in this battle. That's okay, you can show me next time.
\bN: \PN, thanks again for showing me how people and Pokémon can co-exist as partners. Let me show you how that's made me stronger!
\bN: I'm glad that your Pokémon are happy to be with you.
\bN: My bonds with my Pokémon gave me this victory.
\rViola: My lens is always focused on victory!
\rViola: Let me take a picture to celebrate your victory.
